verdict.rationale: The product's own artifacts are stored in open, portable formats. Skills are plain directories with a `SKILL.md` built on the open agent skills standard. Plugins use a portable `plugin.json` Agent Plugins manifest with MCP wiring. A runtime probe confirmed third-party tooling can install catalog skills as plain folders that are not Codex-locked, so a user's skills and plugins can leave with them. However, there is no documented export feature covering all of a user's data. Missing for 10: a documented export of all user data (installed-plugin state, account and usage data, ChatGPT-side skill and plugin data), an explicit off-boarding/export flow, and independent confirmation of a full exit path.
